patch_description:
The current approach uses 5 greedy orderings, 18 transformed-threshold iterations, and 32 move/swap local-search passes. Its transformed packing phase can incorrectly reject a feasible pressure threshold when greedy placement fragments capacity.

This version keeps the transformed KVPR formulation but changes the construction strategy to best-fit decreasing in transformed capacity `load + threshold * size`. For every threshold, it greedily places the prefix and uses a bounded exact recursive completion for the final 7 models (`TAIL_EXACT_MODELS = 7`, `MAX_TAIL_NODES = 40000`). The fallback only accepts a concrete feasible completion, so failed recursion never incorrectly claims infeasibility. It also uses 22 threshold iterations and 28 local-search passes, retaining efficient move and swap refinement afterward.
